newLesson: A temporary filename can change owners after mkstemp returns. The original cleanup's unconditional unlink converted an integrity HOLD into deletion of a foreign file. Pin the opened descriptor inode, fence readback against replacement, and delete only matching inodes on failure. An injected substitution during fsync must be a regression case; never infer ownership from a filename.
